title: Invariants of a tensor product with a field extension under a group with fixed field the base
statement: Let $k\subseteq M$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and $G$ a group of $k$-algebra automorphisms of $M$ whose fixed field is $k$: $\{y\in M:\tau(y)=y\text{ for all }\tau\in G\}=k$. Let $A$ be a $k$-vector space, and for $\tau\in G$ let $\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\tau:A\otimes_kM\to A\otimes_kM$ be the $k$-linear map with $a\otimes y\mapsto a\otimes\tau(y)$. Then the $k$-linear map $\iota:A\to A\otimes_kM$, $a\mapsto a\otimes1$, is injective, and its image is exactly the set of invariants $\{z\in A\otimes_kM:(\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\tau)(z)=z\text{ for all }\tau\in G\}$. (In particular, for a $k$-algebra $A$, $(A\otimes_kM)^G=A\otimes1\cong A$.)

source.place: Varieties, proof of Lemma 038B (lemma-closed-fixed-by-Galois), lines 917-919: '$(A\otimes_kk')^G[T]=A[T]$ (by basic Galois theory)'; the argument (choose a $k$-basis $(e_i)$ of $A$, so $A\otimes_kM=\bigoplus_ie_i\otimes M$ and $\mathrm{id}\otimes\tau$ acts coordinatewise) is not written in the source
